title: Siamese–Vietnamese War (1771–1773)
text: The Siamese–Vietnamese War (1771–1773) was a war between Siam of the Thonburi Period in the reign of King Taksin and the Nguyễn Lords of Cochinchina or Southern Vietnam. The war also involved Cambodia and the Hà Tiên polity, which were allies of the Nguyen Lord.
